Prioritization clarification (Phase 1, /dso:prioritize-epics):

This epic improves the implementation-planning workflow's handling of "migration-style" work — sweeping or repetitive code changes (e.g., method signature changes), framework upgrades, and other patterns that don't decompose cleanly into the smallest-atomic-task model that planning currently assumes. Concrete additions include: using AST tools to trace code paths when available and splitting migration work into an automated pass plus an agent-driven "manual" verification pass; surfacing rollout strategies like feature flags and rollback plans during brainstorming when relevant (e.g., database changes), without applying them unilaterally — they remain user-approved. The two examples (sweeping refactors, DB migrations with rollback) are illustrative, not exhaustive; the epic's intent is broader migration-awareness in planning.
